doc.title: Dan Morgenstern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 9, 2013

title: Reunion with father and arrival in the US in 1947
summary: He reached the US on April 21, 1947, and praises the Danes for rescuing nearly everyone.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: God, that must have been quite an event when you finally got a letter from him.
So since he came here in ’41 he became a citizen after five years, in ’46, and then he was able to get my mother and I to come here in ’47. So I arrived in the U.S.A. in April, April 21st, 1947.
Well I appreciate you telling me that saga. I find it extremely interesting.

Well the Danes were marvelous you know. They did all this, obviously taking great risks, as if it were the most natural thing to do. They got almost everybody out. The people who didn’t get out mostly made mistakes and didn’t follow instructions and that’s why they were caught.
